frases.texto: New dumps appear and grow faster than anyone can map them, and most are never registered.
So we built Dumpsite, a platform that tracks dump sites with NASA's NISAR radar, which images Earth every twelve days.
Radar coherence tells how alike two passes look, and active dumps never stop changing, so we turn that restlessness into our Insomnia score.
Then our LightGBM model, trained on thousands of mapped dumps, classifies each one as a dump or not.
It's all implemented and open, at the links on screen.
